iti16:1.1: 6 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti16:2.1: sekhassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato ajjhattikaṃ aṅganti karitvā na aññaṃ ekaṅgampi samanupassāmi evaṃ bahukāraṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikāro
iti16:2.2: yoniso bhikkhave bhikkhu manasikaronto akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāve tīti.
iti16:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
